Exercise

Q I. Choose the correct one from the given options.

1. The monomer pair required for the formation of Nylon 6,6 is

a. hexamethylene diamine + adipic acid.   b. hexamethylene diamine + sebacoyl chloride.   c. hexamethylene diamine + decanoic acid.   d. hexamethylene amine + ethanedioic acid,

2. Which one is true for DDT?

a. An antibiotic   b. Non pollutant   c. An antiseptic   d. Non-degradable

3. The term black gold is used for

a. coal   b. carbon black   c. petroleum   d. coal tar

4. All are petrochemicals except

a. ethylene oxide   b. polypropylene   c. cellulose   d. cyclohexane

5. Multipart adhesive is an example of

a. reactive adhesives.   b. contact adhesives.   c. hot adhesives.   d. pressure sensitive adhesives.

6. Nail polish removers are mainly composed of

a. propyne   b. propanone   c. propanal   d. propene

7. In the process of cracking

a. small molecule unite together.   b. large molecules unite together.   c. large molecules are broken down.   d. small and large molecules unite together.

8. Rexine is the manipulated form of

a. plastic (PVC)   b. nylon   c. lipstick   d. nail polish

9. Identify the petrochemical which is not obtained from benzene

a. alkyl benzenes   b. cyclohexane   c. nitrobenzene   d. vinyl chloride

10. Which of the following is condensation polymer

a. PVC.   b. polythene.   c. nylon.   d. none of these.

11. (–NH–(CH₂)₆–CONHCO(CH₂)₄CO–)ₙ is an example of

a. addition polymer.   b. thermosetting polymer.   c. condensation copolymer (Nylon-6,6).   d. homo-polymer.

12. Which one of the following is synthetic polymer?

a. cellulose   b. starch   c. silk   d. polythene

13. Hair dyes are commonly classified into groups

a. 3   b. 4   c. 5   d. 6

14. All are synthetic adhesives except

a. casein glues   b. polyurethanes   c. cyanoacrylates   d. polyimides

15. Acrylate base polymers are

a. drying adhesives.   b. pressure sensitive adhesives.   c. contact adhesives.   d. hot adhesives.

13. د وېښتو رنګونه عموماً په څو ډلو ډلبندي کېږي

a. 3   b. 4   c. 5   d. 6

14. ټول مصنوعي سرېښونه دي پرته له

a. کېزین سرېښونه   b. پولي یوریتینونه   c. سیانو اکریلېټونه   d. پولي ایمایډونه

15. د اکریلېټ پر بنسټ پولیمرونه دي

a. وچېدونکي سرېښونه.   b. فشار ته حساس سرېښونه.   c. تماسي سرېښونه.   d. تود سرېښونه.

پوښتنه 2. د لاندې پوښتنو لنډ ځوابونه ولیکئ.

i. د تعاملي او غیر تعاملي سرېښونو ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.

ii. د نوکانو د پالش لرې کوونکی پالش څنګه لرې کوي؟

iii. لنډمهاله رنګونه په یوه ځل شامپو ولې لرې کېږي؟

iv. د PVC لږترلږه څلور کارونې ولیکئ.

v. د پټرو کیمیکل او له هغو څخه د اخیستل شویو کیمیکلونو ترمنځ څه توپیر دی؟

vi. د اضافي او تکثیفي پولیمرونو ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.

vii. تاسو به څنګه ثابت کړئ چې بې اسیتونه د نوکانو د پالش لرې کوونکی د اسیتون پر بنسټ لرې کوونکي څخه غوره دی.

viii. په صنعت کې د کارګرانو لپاره د خوندیتوب ملاحظات څومره مهم دي؟

ix. د پټرولیم د تصفیې اصلي موخه څه ده؟

پوښتنه 3. د لاندې پوښتنو مفصل ځوابونه ولیکئ.

1. (a). د پټرو کیمیکل عملیې ټکنالوژي تشریح کړئ

(b). د کریکنګ بېلابېل ډولونه په تفصیل بیان کړئ.

2. (a). د لپسټکونو چمتو کول او کارونې وڅېړئ.

(b). د نوکانو د پالش ترکیب په تفصیل ولیکئ.

Exercise

Q I. Choose the correct one from the given options.

1. The monomer pair required for the formation of Nylon 6,6 is

a. hexamethylene diamine + adipic acid. b. hexamethylene diamine + sebacoyl chloride. c. hexamethylene diamine + decanoic acid. d. hexamethylene amine + ethanedioic acid,

2. Which one is true for DDT?

a. An antibiotic b. Non pollutant c. An antiseptic d. Non-degradable

3. The term black gold is used for

a. coal b. carbon black c. petroleum d. coal tar

4. All are petrochemicals except

a. ethylene oxide b. polypropylene c. cellulose d. cyclohexane

5. Multipart adhesive is an example of

a. reactive adhesives. b. contact adhesives. c. hot adhesives. d. pressure sensitive adhesives.

6. Nail polish removers are mainly composed of

a. propyne b. propanone c. propanal d. propene

7. In the process of cracking

a. small molecule unite together. b. large molecules unite together. c. large molecules are broken down. d. small and large molecules unite together.

8. Rexine is the manipulated form of

a. plastic (PVC) b. nylon c. lipstick d. nail polish

9. Identify the petrochemical which is not obtained from benzene

a. alkyl benzenes b. cyclohexane c. nitrobenzene d. vinyl chloride

10. Which of the following is condensation polymer

a. PVC. b. polythene. c. nylon. d. none of these.

11. (–NH–(CH₂)₆–CONHCO(CH₂)₄CO–)ₙ is an example of

a. addition polymer. b. thermosetting polymer. c. condensation copolymer (Nylon-6,6). d. homo-polymer.

12. Which one of the following is synthetic polymer?

a. cellulose b. starch c. silk d. polythene

13. Hair dyes are commonly classified into groups

a. 3 b. 4 c. 5 d. 6

14. All are synthetic adhesives except

a. casein glues b. polyurethanes c. cyanoacrylates d. polyimides

15. Acrylate base polymers are

a. drying adhesives. b. pressure sensitive adhesives. c. contact adhesives. d. hot adhesives.

Q2. Write short answers of the following questions.

i. Differentiate between reactive and non-reactive adhesives.

ii. How nail-polish remover removes the nail polish?

iii. Why temporary hair dyes are removed with single shampooing?

iv. Write down at least four uses of PVC.

v. What is the difference between petrochemical and chemicals derived from them?

vi. Differentiate between addition and condensation polymers.

vii. How would you justify that non-acetone base nail polish remover is better than acetone base nail polish remover.

viii. How important the safety consideration for the workers in industry?

ix. What is main goal of petroleum refining?

Q3. Write detail answers of the following questions.

1. (a). Explain the Petrochemical Process Technology

(b). Describe the different types of cracking in detail.

2. (a). Discuss the preparation and applications of lipsticks.

(b). Write down in detail the composition of nail polish.
